meta.name: fastapi-templates
meta.description: Create production-ready FastAPI projects with async patterns, dependency injection, and comprehensive error handling. Use when building new FastAPI applications or setting up backend API projects.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建带异步与依赖注入的生产级后端 API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正准备新建一个 FastAPI 后端项目，想拥有一个良好结构的起点。
copy.tagline_en: Build production-ready FastAPI backends with async patterns and dependency injection.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to build a new FastAPI backend and want a well-structured starting point.

howto.what: 装上后,当你让它新建 FastAPI 项目,它会生成一个推荐的项目骨架,包含 api、core、models、schemas、services、repositories 等目录;代码采用异步处理和依赖注入的方式组织,并包含错误处理。
howto.when: 当你说要新建 FastAPI 应用、搭建后端 API 项目,或实现异步 REST API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 FastAPI 搭一个新项目,用推荐的目录结构。
say.note: 会生成 api、core 等目录骨架。

say.text: 给这个 FastAPI 项目写一个用户接口的测试。
say.note: 会输出 pytest + httpx 的测试示例。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask it to create a FastAPI project, it generates a recommended project skeleton with folders like api, core, models, schemas, services, and repositories. The code uses async patterns and dependency injection, and includes error handling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say you want to create a new FastAPI project, set up a backend API project, or implement an async REST API.

say_en.text: Create a new FastAPI project with the recommended folder structure.
I need an async REST API with PostgreSQL. Set up a FastAPI project.
Write a test for the user endpoint in this FastAPI project.
